WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
    AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
all_album_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
  ar.AlbumId,
  ar.avg_unit_price,
  ar.avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
  ar.avg_bytes_per_millisecond - aaa.avg_bytes_per_millisecond AS above_all_album_average
FROM album_rates AS ar
CROSS JOIN all_album_average AS aaa
ORDER BY above_all_album_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
